## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one concern and unrelated refactoring was avoided.
- [ ] Tests or validation were added/updated when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior, configuration, or public contracts changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, or sensitive logs were added.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are explicitly documented, or this change is backward compatible.
